Checked by reading the source: &9F (top_palette_value), &A0 (firing_frame) and &B6 (delta_low/first_mover/target) are named only in zp.6502 (the symbol dump has no other assignment at those addresses), and none of the renderer's sources (render, render_zp, prebuild, sky*, kindcache*, compiled*, sprite*, shield*, timer*, run, credits, scroll_hazel, lib/*) uses those names or literals except render_zp's own save/restore. Their writers in game.6502 (add/subtract_delta_*, walk_column, rows_up, to_title_screen/start_game, search_for_target, the firing code) are all the logic's; the game routines render calls between save_game_zp (render.6502:338) and its closing JMP restore_game_zp (563) are check_if_mover_is_on_screen (writes none of them) and compiled_call; write_column only copies the history. No indexed zero-page writes in renderer code; save_ptr &9C/&9D, plot_sprite &9E, sky &A8-&AF never offset onto the three. The vsync/User VIA handler only reads top_palette_value; sfx50/keydown use none. So the restores store back what is already there. The dropped LDA zp_save+21 and LDA zp_save+25 only set A/N/Z, overwritten by the next LDA; exit A and flags (from LDA zp_save+33) unchanged. LDA zp_save+17 (line 120) is left dead but harmless. zp_save is read nowhere else. Recount: STA &9F 3c/2b, LDA +18 4/3, STA &A0 3/2, LDA +21 4/3, LDA +25 4/3, STA &B6 3/2 = 21 cycles, 15 bytes, once a pass. Room: it shrinks bank 4's under-ANDY code (ROMSEL &04 as before). Caveat on relies_on: render_bss_zero is NOT the only code after restore_game_zp; sky_off.6502 (and sky_edges, or shield.6502 in gameplay builds) follow and move 15 bytes down, but no ASSERT or alignment depends on their address, the listing shows no branch in &8D95-&8FFF whose page-crossing changes with a -15 shift (the two crossing ones, &8EF6 BMI and &8EFC BCC, cross both before and after), and no indexed read of a table in that range; the speed gate covers gameplay builds.
